prompt: Write me a quick script to list all running containers and their ports.
output:
Or if you want more detail per container:

```powershell
docker ps --format "{{.Names}}" | ForEach-Object {
    Write-Host "`n$_"
    docker port $_
}
```

The one-liner `docker ps --format "table {{.Names}}\t{{.Ports}}\t{{.Status}}"` covers most cases — saved to `containers.ps1`. Run it with `.\containers.ps1` or just paste it directly.
